mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an aggressive monetary easing response to the financial crisis, which reduces the risk-free rate and increases the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% in a 3-month window, it signals a deteriorating labor market that triggers a flight to quality in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has risen above 5.0% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to reduced corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply-side shock characterized by a sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate output and profit margins, with the effect amplified in high-inflation environments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines by more than 2% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL is above 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been above 4.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a severe labor market contraction, which triggers a risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% and PAYEMS declines by more than 100k in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime characterized by rising consumer spending, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings rebound from the financial crisis.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during the post-shock recovery regime (defined by RSAFS growth > 0.5% MoM for 3 months), or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO has declined for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.
